summary: The proposed commercial experiment requires human approval before screening or any model, agent, paid, or external action.
evidence: No experiment execution or external write is recorded
requested_decision: Approve, revise, or reject the proposed experiment design before screening begins.
tradeoffs: Approving screening tests candidate availability but still supplies no authority to recruit, execute models, spend, or write externally.
Revising the design delays screening but can improve causal and commercial measurement before any exposure.
Rejecting preserves all budgets and closes this experiment family without testing demand.
recommended_choice: Request design review, then approve screening only if the baseline, treatment, customer access, and external acceptance path are credible.
